ARMO.name: Armor
ARMO.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/ARMO. Skyrim's armor carries a body template, a base value and a weight, and separate male and female models. [measured: 2,762 ARMO records in Skyrim.esm; DATA is 8 bytes and BOD2 is 8 bytes in almost all of them]

BAMT.name: Bash Material
BAMT.note: The MATT. Only shields have one.

BIDS.name: Bash Impact Data Set
BIDS.note: The IPDS. Only shields have one.

BOD2.name: Body Template
BOD2.note: The body template, 8 bytes. The armor type is in BODT, which is 12 bytes. [measured: BOD2 is 8 bytes in 2,752 of Skyrim.esm's 2,762 ARMO records, and BODT is 8 or 12 bytes in the other ten]

BODT.name: Body Template
BODT.note: The body template, 8 or 12 bytes. The 12-byte form carries the armor type as well. [measured: 766 of Skyrim.esm's ARMO records have a BODT and the rest have a BOD2]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The armour's base value and weight.

DESC.name: Description
DESC.note: Usually zero, unless the enchantment is not a standard one such as the Archmage Robes.

DEST.name: Destruction Data
DEST.note: The destructible object data, with the DSTD, DMDL, DMDT and DMDS fields.

DNAM.name: Armor Rating
DNAM.note: The base armor rating times a hundred. Only the lower sixteen bits are used.

EITM.name: Enchantment
EITM.note: The enchantment (ENCH). There can be only one.

ETYP.name: Equip Slot
ETYP.note: The EQUP record. Only shields have one.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: The keywords. There is one per KSIZ, and KSIZ is a sibling subrecord rather than a count in the data, so the count comes from it.

MO2S.name: Male Alternate Textures
MO2S.note: The alternate textures, used when overriding a nif's textures with texture sets.

MO4S.name: Female Alternate Textures
MO4S.note: The alternate textures, used when overriding a nif's textures with texture sets.

MOD2.name: Male Model
MOD2.note: The male model, relative to MaleModels\.

MOD4.name: Female Model
MOD4.note: The female model, relative to FemaleModels\.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The armour's model, with the MODB, MODT, MODS and MODD fields.

OBND.name: Object Bounds
OBND.note: Always 12 bytes, even when all zero.

RNAM.name: Race
RNAM.note: The RACE the armour is for. It is 0x19, the default race, for most records.

TNAM.name: Template
TNAM.note: The ARMO record to use as a template.

YNAM.name: Pickup Sound
YNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the armour is picked up.

ZNAM.name: Drop Sound
ZNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the armour is dropped.

CELL.name: Cell
CELL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CELL. A cell holds either an interior or an exterior, in a top group of its own or inside a worldspace. [measured: 15,269 MHDT fields of 1,028 bytes each and 6,019 TVDT fields of 684 bytes each in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: Flags
DATA.note: The cell's flags. The field is one byte in 331 of Skyrim.esm's 17,568 cells and two bytes in the rest.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

MHDT.name: Max Height Data
MHDT.note: The per-quad height ceilings the dragon flight system uses to work out the clearance over the cell's exterior airspace. The terrain rendering does not use it.

XCCM.name: Climate
XCCM.note: The climate, for an interior cell that behaves like an exterior one. It is only in interior cells.

XCLC.name: Grid Location
XCLC.note: The cell's grid location and flags. Always in an exterior cell and never in an interior one.

XCLL.name: Lighting
XCLL.note: The cell's lighting, 92 bytes in most cells and 64 in one. The layout is not documented in full, so it is left opaque.

XCLR.name: Regions
XCLR.note: The regions containing the cell. It is a run of formids with no count of its own.

XILL.name: Unknown
XILL.note: The id of an NPC_ or a FLST. It is only in interior cells.

XOWN.name: Owner
XOWN.note: The owning NPC or faction. It is only in interior cells.

XWCN.name: Water Current Size
XWCN.note: The size of the XWCU divided by sixteen. Only one occurrence, with the value 0x04.

XWCS.name: Water Current Size
XWCS.note: The size of the XWCU divided by sixteen. The CK changes this into the use of XWCN, and it always has the value three in Skyrim.esm.

XWCU.name: Unknown
XWCU.note: The water current's linear and angular velocity, and a struct of zeroes. The layout is not documented, so it is left opaque.

XWEM.name: Water Environment Map
XWEM.note: The water environment map. It is only in interior cells.

FACT.name: Faction
FACT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. [measured: 996 VENV fields in Skyrim.esm]

CRGR.name: Crime Group
CRGR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Crime Factions List (FLST)

CRVA.name: Crime Gold
CRVA.note: The crime gold, a struct of 12, 16 or 20 bytes depending on the record version.

CTDA.name: CTDA
CTDA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Conditions, with leading CITC field. Vendor will only buy/sell when these conditions are met.

DATA.name: flags
DATA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Flags

EDID.name: editorID
EDID.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Faction name

FNAM.name: Female Rank Title
FNAM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Female title

FULL.name: name
FULL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Full name

JAIL.name: Prison Marker
JAIL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. REFR formid - The exterior jail marker for the faction's prison.

JOUT.name: Jail Outfit
JOUT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. OTFT formid - Jail outfit the player is given.

MNAM.name: Male Rank Title
MNAM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Male title

PLCN.name: Player Belongings Chest
PLCN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. REFR formid - Player's inventory is stored in this chest.

PLVD.name: PLVD
PLVD.note: Where the goods may be sold.

RNAM.name: Rank ID
RNAM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Rank ID

STOL.name: Evidence Chest
STOL.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. REFR formid - Stolen goods are stored in this chest.

VENC.name: Vendor Chest
VENC.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Reference to vendor chest (REFR)

VEND.name: Vendor List
VEND.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. Merchandise list (FLST)

VENV.name: VENV
VENV.note: The vendor's hours and radius. It is all zeroes unless the faction is a vendor, and it is always present from record version 29 on and never before it.

WAIT.name: Follower Wait Marker
WAIT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/FACT. REFR formid - Marker the player's followers are assigned to wait at.

XNAM.name: Interfaction Relations
XNAM.note: The faction's relations with another faction.

LCTN.name: Location
LCTN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCTN. A location holds the population that belongs to it: the actors, the unique actors, the static references and the enable points. [measured: 572 LCSR and 354 LCEC fields in Skyrim.esm]

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: A KYWD record. There is one per KSIZ.

LCEC.name: Encounter
LCEC.note: The encounter zone the location sits in.

LCEP.name: Enable Points
LCEP.note: The points at which the location's actors are enabled.

LCPR.name: Population References
LCPR.note: The actors that populate the location.

LCSR.name: Static References
LCSR.note: The location's static references, each with the ref type that finds them.

RCPR.name: Population References
RCPR.note: The actors. There is only one instance of this in the game data.

NAVI.name: Navmesh Info
NAVI.note: Skyrim's NAVI holds one NVMI per navmesh triangle group. The layout is not documented: UESP's NAVM page gives only the signature, and Fallout's layout does not fit. Measured on Skyrim.esm, the 15,462 NVMI records run from 49 to 3,021 bytes, and a field four bytes in at offset 24 counts up in step with the length, but no field explains the length on its own. The contents are therefore read as raw bytes rather than decoded field by field.

NVCI.name: Connection
NVCI.note: The navmesh's connections. The layout is not documented, so it is read as raw bytes.

NVMI.name: Navmesh Info
NVMI.note: The navmesh's geometry. The layout is not documented, so it is read as raw bytes.

REFR.name: Reference
REFR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/REFR. A reference places a base object in the world. INAM means two things: the image space in the header, and the patrol data's idle name in the marker set. The header's INAM is the one decoded here, since the idle name is far rarer. [measured: 10,103 XLIG, 8,783 XLRT, 3,179 PDTO and 2,702 XLIB fields in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: Locational Data
DATA.note: The reference's x, y and z position and rotation, in radians. The floor of x or y divided by 4096 gives the cell location.

FNAM.name: Marker Flags
FNAM.note: 0x01 = Visible, 0x02 = Can Travel To, 0x04 = Show All Hidden.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The marker's name in the game.

INAM.name: Image Space
INAM.note: The image space. INAM is used differently in another context.

NAME.name: Base Object
NAME.note: The formid of whatever the reference places.

ONAM.name: Marker
ONAM.note: Zero-length; it appears with XACT when the object is open by default.

PDTO.name: Patrol Data Topic
PDTO.note: The same struct as PACK's PDTO field.

TNAM.name: Marker Type
TNAM.note: The icon for the map marker, an enumeration.

XACT.name: Activation
XACT.note: Always 0x0d. It appears with ONAM when the object is open by default.

XALP.name: Alpha Cutoff
XALP.note: The current and default alpha cutoffs. Which one the CK shows is not always clear.

XAPR.name: Activation Parent
XAPR.note: The REFR to activate, usually a STAT, and the delay.

XCNT.name: Item Count
XCNT.note: How many items are in the container, when there is more than one.

XCVL.name: Water Current Linear Velocity
XCVL.note: The x, y and z linear velocity of the water current.

XCVR.name: Water Current Rotational Velocity
XCVR.note: The x, y and z rotational velocity of the water current.

XIS2.name: Marker
XIS2.note: Zero-length; present when the reference is ignored by something.

XLCM.name: Type
XLCM.note: Only the values 0x00, 0x02 and 0x03 are seen.

XLIB.name: Leveled Item Base
XLIB.note: The LVLI of the objects that use this as a base.

XLIG.name: Light Data
XLIG.note: The light's field of view offset, fade offset, end distance cap and shadow depth bias, plus four unknown bytes.

XLKR.name: Linked Reference
XLKR.note: The keyword and the REFR the reference is linked to, usually a STAT.

XLOC.name: Lock Information
XLOC.note: The lock's level, its key and its flags.

XLRL.name: Unknown
XLRL.note: An LCTN. It is not in the shipped .esm files, and the CK adds it when the reference is edited.

XLRM.name: Location Room Marker
XLRM.note: A REFR, usually to a STAT.

XMBO.name: Model Bounds
XMBO.note: The x, y and z bounds. They are usually the same as the XPRM bounds.

XNDP.name: Door Pivot
XNDP.note: The navmesh triangle the door pivots on.

XOWN.name: Owner
XOWN.note: The owner. It is usually a FACT, but a horse or a dog has an NPC_.

XPOD.name: Portal Destination
XPOD.note: The origin and destination REFR of a portal.

XPPA.name: Marker
XPPA.note: Zero-length. XPRD, XPPA, PDTO and INAM are a set.

XPRM.name: Primitive
XPRM.note: The reference's primitive: its bounds, its colour and its shape.

XPWR.name: Reflected By
XPWR.note: The reference that reflects this one.

XRDS.name: Radius
XRDS.note: About 1.25. It controls the radii on objects like lights.

XRGD.name: Ragdoll Data
XRGD.note: A long binary stream whose contents are not understood.

XRMR.name: Reference Marker
XRMR.note: The marker the reference sits in, and how many XLRM follow.

XTEL.name: Door Teleport
XTEL.note: The door the teleport goes to, and where.

XTRI.name: Primitive
XTRI.note: The primitive's collision layer, chosen by matching the BNAM field of a COLL form.

XWCN.name: Water Current Count
XWCN.note: The size of the XWCU divided by sixteen.

XWCU.name: Water Current
XWCU.note: The water current, a series of sixteen-byte structures. There seem to be three of them.

STAT.name: Static
STAT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/STAT. [measured: 824 MNAM fields in Skyrim.esm]

DNAM.name: Data
DNAM.note: The static's maximum angle and its directional material.

MNAM.name: LOD Data
MNAM.note: The static's level of detail models, present when the HasDistanceLOD flag is set. It is 1,040 bytes: four 260-byte model paths, from the high detail model to the low detail one, with junk after each terminated string. The first empty string is the lowest detail model, so if the second is empty the third and fourth are too.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The static's model, with the MODB, MODT, MODS and MODD fields.

RNAM.name: Race
RNAM.note: The RACE the static belongs to.

WRLD.name: Worldspace
WRLD.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WRLD. A worldspace holds a nested group with a CELL and the exterior cell blocks. [measured: 11,105 RNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, holding the large references that place a base object of object size 512 or greater]

DNAM.name: Land Data
DNAM.note: The default land and ocean water levels. They are -27000 and -14000.0 for Tamriel.

EDID.name: Editor ID
EDID.note: The worldspace's name in the construction kit.

FULL.name: Name
FULL.note: The worldspace's name in the game.

MHDT.name: Max Height Data
MHDT.note: Eight bytes of the min and max x and y cell grid coordinates, then an ordered array of four-byte structs listing the max heights per quad in each cell. The four bytes are zero when the cell the entry refers to does not exist.

MNAM.name: Map Size
MNAM.note: The map's size, its corner cells and the camera's height and pitch limits.

MODL.name: Cloud Model
MODL.note: The cloud model, with an optional MODT.

NAM3.name: LOD Water Type
NAM3.note: The LOD water type. It is always a WATR formid.

NAM4.name: LOD Water Height
NAM4.note: The LOD ocean water level. It is -14000.0 for Tamriel.

OFST.name: Unknown
OFST.note: An unknown field whose size varies with the worldspace. [observed: 120 to 113,836 bytes]

RNAM.name: Large References
RNAM.note: The references that place a base object of object size 512 or greater, with the cell each one is in.

WCTR.name: Fixed Dimension Center Cell
WCTR.note: The centre cell's x and y coordinates.

struct.name: armor_type
struct.note: The armor type. Only the 12-byte BODT has it; the 8-byte BOD2 does not.

struct.name: value
struct.note: The base value. For unenchanted armor this is the gold value.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: The cell's flags. The field is sometimes only one byte long. The Can't Travel From Here flag is only valid for interior cells.

struct.name: anchor
struct.note: The vertical reference, usually near the cell's terrain minimum.

struct.name: grid
struct.note: A 32 by 32 grid of per-quad height ceilings, column-major. The byte at index col * 32 + row covers the 128 by 128 game unit quad at (col, row), with col 0 the west edge and row 0 the south edge. Each byte is the maximum height for that quad above the anchor, and vanilla cells use roughly 110 game units per step. The terrain rendering does not use this; LAND's VHGT gives the ground geometry separately.

struct.name: x
struct.note: The cell's x coordinate in the grid.

struct.name: y
struct.note: The cell's y coordinate in the grid.

struct.name: specification_type
struct.note: Where the goods may be sold. 2 and 6 are not used in the original files.

struct.name: location
struct.note: The reference, cell or keyword, depending on the specification type.

struct.name: start_hour
struct.note: The hour the vendor starts at.

struct.name: end_hour
struct.note: The hour the vendor stops at.

struct.name: radius
struct.note: The radius the vendor trades in.

struct.name: buys_stolen
struct.note: 1 = the vendor buys stolen items. The CK's wording is misleading.

struct.name: no_trade
struct.note: 1 = the vendor does not sell or buy, so it trades everything except what is in the vendor list.

struct.name: modifier
struct.note: A modifier that appears to be unused: it is no longer editable in the CK and is only non-zero for one faction.

struct.name: combat
struct.note: How the two factions treat each other.

struct.name: world
struct.note: The WRLD the encounter zone is in.

struct.name: unknown
struct.note: Extra data that varies considerably, though the first byte is always zero.

struct.name: location
struct.note: The CELL or WRLD the actor is in. 0x3C is Tamriel.

struct.name: location
struct.note: The CELL or WRLD the reference is in. 0x3C is Tamriel.

struct.name: location
struct.note: The LCTN, which points to itself in most cases.

struct.name: reference
struct.note: A REFR, usually to a STAT.

struct.name: fov_offset
struct.note: The field of view offset from the base object, in degrees.

struct.name: fade_offset
struct.note: The fade offset from the base object.

struct.name: keyword
struct.note: Zero, or a KYWD — usually LinkCarryStart or LinkCarryEnd.

struct.name: reference
struct.note: A REFR, usually to a STAT. FURN also appears here.

struct.name: level
struct.note: The lock's level: -1 requires a key, 0 is Novice, 25 is Apprentice, 50 is Adept, 75 is Expert and 100 is Master.

struct.name: flags1
struct.note: Flags, whose meaning is not known.

struct.name: flags2
struct.note: Flags, whose meaning is mostly not known.

struct.name: flags3
struct.note: Flags, whose meaning is not known.

struct.name: navmesh
struct.note: The NAVM the pivot is on.

struct.name: unknown
struct.note: 0.15, 0.2, 0.25 and 1.0 are seen; the same for any given base object.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: The values 0x01 to 0x20 appear to be unknown.

struct.name: destination
struct.note: The DOOR the teleport goes to.

struct.name: position
struct.note: The x, y and z position.

struct.name: rotation
struct.note: The x, y and z rotation, in radians.

struct.name: width
struct.note: The usable width of the map.

struct.name: height
struct.note: The usable height of the map.

struct.name: min_height
struct.note: The camera's minimum height. The default is 50000. New as of Skyrim 1.8, and its purpose is not known.

struct.name: max_height
struct.note: The camera's maximum height. The default is 80000.

struct.name: initial_pitch
struct.note: The camera's initial pitch. The default is 50.

struct.name: references
struct.note: The references that place a base object of object size 512 or greater. Such references change from the full model to the LOD at grid 11 rather than 5.
